text:
frank: Quick alert: promote job 69302 failed with 'blob not found' for digest sha256:bb33... trying to promote canary->prod. Looks like registry returned 404.

gina: Ugh. Any chance this is the known pruner race? Which repo?

frank: repo=redwood/feature-embed service, tag=canary. Logs show prune happened ~5s before promote pull.

infra-bot: prune-worker[aa3]: removed orphaned blobs for repo=redwood/feature-embed older_than=72h candidate=sha256:bb33...

ci-bot: CI 69302 promote-step failed: exit 1. https://ci.redwood.internal/69302 (promote)

frank: deploy-bot error: `pull failed: manifest references missing blob sha256:bb33...`

harry: Two immediate recovery paths: 1) roll back promote to prev digest, or 2) rehydrate blob from build cache and retry. Which has lower blast radius?

gina: Rolling back is simpler but will delay the release until next window. Rehydrate might be faster if build cache present.

frank: Can someone check runner artifacts? s3://ci-build-cache/69302/service/feature-embed/sha256-bb33.tar.gz

harry: I'm on it. If the tar exists we can push to registry mirror and re-run promote.

infra-bot: runner-cache lookup: s3 key exists. size=124MB sha256 matches.

frank: Ok push plan: pause prune for repo, upload blob, then retry promote. I'll take manual hold on cut.

gina: How to pause prune? We don't want to stop the entire pruner cluster. Can we add a temporary skip label?

harry: Quick hack: scale down job for that repo label: `kubectl -n infra annotate job/cache-pruner skip-repo=redwood/feature-embed --overwrite` (pruner watches annotation). Doing now.

infra-bot: Annotation applied to cache-pruner controllers: skip-repo=redwood/feature-embed

frank: Pushing artifact from runner cache -> registry mirror: `aws s3 cp ... && crane push --tar ... registry-internal.redwood/redwood/feature-embed@sha256:bb33...`

ci-bot: builder-23: started upload by harry.

harry: Upload complete. Registry returning digest.

deploy-bot: Notified of new digest, attempting promote retry.

deploy-bot: Promote retry failed with timeout contacting registry for manifest. (retry 1/3)

frank: Weird. Check registry health and throttles.

gina: Registry spike on upload shards, hitting 429 on some mirrors. Ops notified.

infra-bot: registry[http]: 429 from shard-7 for PUT /v2/redwood/feature-embed/blobs/uploads/ -> retrying

harry: Switched to primary mirror, re-pushed blob successfully.

deploy-bot: Promote retry succeeded. canary -> prod promoted. :tada:

frank: Re-enable normal pruning behavior after patch lands. Created INFRA-1290 "pruner: ignore active promote sessions".

gina: For release notes: include short blurb about transient prune race and mitigation applied. Also mention we had to hold the cut for ~20m.

frank: Filing postmortem stub and tagging oncall. Will add timeline tomorrow.

ci-bot: CI 69302 now shows success and post-promote smoke tests passed.

harry: Follow-up: we should add a promote-lock metric and make pruner consult promote ledger before deleting.

gina: Agree. Also add an alert for prune deletions within active-change-windows.

frank: Closing thread. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
